name: runtime-declaration-applicability
goal: Require runtime profiling for actual executable initialization while exempting parsed ambient and type declarations; unreadable and mixed source remain required.

evidence: Actual SourceIndex probe: type exports mask a side-effect import and a module call; ambient declare-global plus export-empty incorrectly requires runtime profiling. Saved probe shows all three classification mismatches.

Extend standardized performance-evidence matrix with actual indexed source. Existing type-only case mutates exports metadata, so it misses top-level execution and ambient declarations. Keep CSS, unreadable, mixed, callable and fixture-boundary guards.
